recipes.name: Buttermilk Waffles with Berries
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups all-purpose flour
2 tbsp sugar
2 tsp baking powder
1/2 tsp salt
2 large eggs
1 3/4 cups buttermilk
1/2 cup butter, melted
1 cup mixed berries
recipes.directions:
Heat the waffle iron. Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a large bowl.
Beat the eggs with the buttermilk and melted butter, then stir into the dry ingredients until just combined.
Cook in the waffle iron for 4 minutes until golden. Serve with berries.

recipes.name: Overnight Oats with Blueberries
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup rolled oats
1 cup milk
1/2 cup plain yogurt
1 tbsp honey
1 cup blueberries
recipes.directions:
Stir the oats, milk, yogurt and honey together in a jar.
Cover and chill for 8 hours or overnight.
Top with blueberries before serving.

recipes.name: Tomato Basil Toasts
recipes.ingredients:
1 baguette, sliced
4 tomatoes, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1/4 cup fresh basil, chopped
3 tbsp olive oil
Salt and pepper to taste
recipes.directions:
Toast the baguette slices under the grill for 2 minutes.
Mix the tomatoes, garlic, basil and olive oil. Season.
Spoon onto the toasts and serve at once.

recipes.name: Maple Bacon Cupcakes
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
1 cup sugar
1/2 cup butter
2 eggs
1/2 cup milk
1/4 cup maple syrup
4 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled
recipes.directions:
Heat the oven to 350°F.
Cream the butter and sugar, beat in the eggs, then fold in flour and milk.
Bake for 18 minutes. Cool, drizzle with maple syrup and top with bacon.

recipes.name: Dark Chocolate Tart
recipes.ingredients:
1 pie crust
8 oz dark chocolate, chopped
1 cup heavy cream
2 tbsp butter
1 pinch salt
recipes.directions:
Blind bake the crust for 15 minutes.
Heat the cream until steaming and pour over the chocolate. Stir in butter and salt.
Pour into the crust and chill for 2 hours.

recipes.name: Weeknight Spaghetti Bolognese
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground beef
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 can crushed tomatoes (28 oz)
2 tbsp tomato paste
1 lb spaghetti
1/2 cup parmesan cheese, grated
recipes.directions:
Brown the beef with the onion for 8 minutes.
Add garlic, tomatoes and paste. Simmer for 25 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti, drain and toss with the sauce. Top with parmesan.

recipes.name: Layered Jar Salad
recipes.ingredients:
2 tbsp vinaigrette
1/2 cup chickpeas
1/2 cucumber, diced
1 cup cherry tomatoes
1/4 cup feta cheese
2 cups lettuce
recipes.directions:
Pour the dressing into the bottom of a large jar.
Layer chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes and feta, then the lettuce on top.
Shake into a bowl to serve.

recipes.name: Spiced Carrot Cake
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups all-purpose flour
2 tsp cinnamon
1 tsp baking soda
4 eggs
1 1/2 cups sugar
1 cup vegetable oil
3 cups carrots, grated
8 oz cream cheese
recipes.directions:
Heat the oven to 350°F and grease two cake pans.
Whisk the eggs, sugar and oil, then fold in flour, cinnamon, soda and carrots.
Bake for 30 minutes. Cool and frost with cream cheese.

recipes.name: Orange Cream Cupcakes
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups flour
3/4 cup sugar
1/2 cup butter
2 eggs
1 orange, zested and juiced
1 cup whipped cream
recipes.directions:
Heat the oven to 350°F.
Mix everything except the cream until smooth and bake for 20 minutes.
Pipe whipped cream on the cooled cupcakes.

recipes.name: Peach Smoothie
recipes.ingredients:
2 peaches, sliced
1 banana
3/4 cup orange juice
1/2 cup yogurt
1 cup ice
recipes.directions:
Blend everything until smooth, about 1 minute.
Pour into glasses and serve right away.

recipes.name: Caramel Custard with Raspberries
recipes.ingredients:
3/4 cup sugar
4 eggs
2 cups milk
1 tsp vanilla extract
1 cup raspberries
recipes.directions:
Melt half the sugar into a caramel and pour into ramekins.
Whisk eggs, milk, the rest of the sugar and vanilla. Pour over the caramel.
Bake in a water bath at 325°F for 40 minutes. Chill for 4 hours and serve with raspberries.

recipes.name: Thin Crepes
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup flour
2 eggs
1 1/4 cups milk
2 tbsp butter, melted
1 pinch salt
recipes.directions:
Whisk everything into a smooth batter and rest for 30 minutes.
Cook thin rounds in a hot buttered pan for 1 minute per side.

recipes.name: Roasted Pumpkin Soup
recipes.ingredients:
2 lbs pumpkin, cubed
1 onion, chopped
3 cups vegetable broth, low sodium
1/2 cup cream or half and half
1 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp nutmeg
recipes.directions:
Roast the pumpkin with oil at 400°F for 35 minutes.
Soften the onion, add pumpkin and broth and simmer for 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth, stir in the cream and nutmeg.

recipes.name: Avocado Egg Toast
recipes.ingredients:
2 slices sprouted wheat bread, toasted
1 avocado
2 eggs
1 tsp lemon juice
1 pinch chili flakes
recipes.directions:
Mash the avocado with lemon juice and spread on the toast.
Fry or poach the eggs for 3 minutes and place on top.
Finish with chili flakes.

recipes.name: Garlic Butter Shrimp
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb shrimp, peeled
4 tbsp butter
4 cloves garlic, minced
1 lemon, juiced
2 tbsp parsley, chopped
recipes.directions:
Melt the butter and cook the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the shrimp and cook for 3 minutes per side.
Finish with lemon juice and parsley.

recipes.name: Margherita Flatbread Pizza
recipes.ingredients:
1 pizza dough
1/2 cup tomato sauce
8 oz mozzarella cheese
1/4 cup fresh basil leaves
1 tbsp olive oil
recipes.directions:
Heat the oven to 500°F.
Stretch the dough, spread the sauce and add the mozzarella.
Bake for 10 minutes and top with basil and oil.

recipes.name: Grilled Steaks with Mushrooms
recipes.ingredients:
2 ribeye steaks
8 oz mushrooms, sliced
1/2 cup beef broth
2 tbsp butter
2 sprigs thyme
recipes.directions:
Grill the steaks for 5 minutes per side and rest for 10 minutes.
Sauté the mushrooms in butter with thyme, add the broth and reduce for 5 minutes.
Spoon over the steaks.

recipes.name: Simple Marinara Sauce
recipes.ingredients:
2 cans whole tomatoes (28 oz)
3 tbsp olive oil
4 cloves garlic, sliced
1 tsp dried oregano
Salt to taste
recipes.directions:
Warm the oil and garlic for 2 minutes.
Add tomatoes and oregano, crush and simmer for 30 minutes.

recipes.name: Vanilla Bean Crème Brûlée
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups heavy cream
6 egg yolks
1/4 cup granulated sugar
1 tsp vanilla extract
Pinch of salt
Demerara sugar, for topping
Fresh mixed berries, for garnish
recipes.directions:
Heat the oven to 325°F. Whisk the egg yolks and sugar until smooth, then whisk in the cream, vanilla and salt.
Pour into ramekins set in a roasting pan and add hot water halfway up their sides.
Bake for 35 minutes until just set. Chill for 4 hours.
Sprinkle with demerara sugar and torch until caramelised. Serve with berries.

recipes.name: Lemon Herb Roast Chicken
recipes.ingredients:
1 whole chicken (4 lbs)
1 lemon, halved
4 cloves garlic
2 tbsp butter, softened
1 tbsp fresh thyme
Salt and pepper
recipes.directions:
Heat the oven to 425°F.
Rub the chicken with butter, thyme, salt and pepper; stuff with lemon and garlic.
Roast for 1 hour 15 minutes and rest for 15 minutes before carving.

recipes.name: Chicken Tikka Masala
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lbs chicken breast, cubed
1 cup plain yogurt
2 tbsp garam masala
1 onion, diced
4 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp ginger, grated
1 can crushed tomatoes (15 oz)
1/2 cup heavy cream
2 tbsp butter
1/4 cup cilantro, chopped
recipes.directions:
Toss the chicken with the yogurt and half the garam masala; marinate for 30 minutes.
Sear the chicken in butter for 6 minutes and set aside.
Soften the onion, garlic and ginger, add the rest of the garam masala and the tomatoes, and simmer for 15 minutes.
Stir in the cream and chicken and simmer for 10 minutes. Top with cilantro.

recipes.name: Chana Masala
recipes.ingredients:
2 cans chickpeas (15 oz), drained
1 onion, diced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp ginger, grated
1 can diced tomatoes (15 oz)
1 tbsp garam masala
1 tsp cumin
2 tbsp vegetable oil
1 lemon, juiced
recipes.directions:
Cook the onion in oil for 8 minutes, then add garlic, ginger and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and chickpeas and simmer for 20 minutes.
Finish with lemon juice and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Pad Thai
recipes.ingredients:
8 oz rice noodles
8 oz shrimp, peeled
2 eggs
3 tbsp fish sauce
2 tbsp brown sugar
2 tbsp lime juice
1 cup bean sprouts
3 green onions, sliced
1/4 cup peanuts, chopped
2 tbsp vegetable oil
recipes.directions:
Soak the noodles in hot water for 8 minutes and drain.
Stir-fry the shrimp in oil for 2 minutes, push aside and scramble the eggs.
Add noodles, fish sauce, sugar and lime juice and toss for 2 minutes.
Fold in sprouts and green onions; top with peanuts.

recipes.name: Thai Green Curry
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb chicken thighs, sliced
3 tbsp green curry paste
1 can coconut milk (14 oz)
1 cup green beans
1 bell pepper, sliced
1 tbsp fish sauce
1 tsp brown sugar
1/4 cup fresh basil leaves
recipes.directions:
Fry the curry paste in a little coconut milk for 2 minutes.
Add the chicken and cook for 5 minutes, then the rest of the coconut milk.
Add the vegetables, fish sauce and sugar and simmer for 10 minutes. Finish with basil.

recipes.name: Beef Street Tacos
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground beef
1 tbsp chili powder
1 tsp cumin
12 small corn tortillas
1 onion, finely diced
1/2 cup cilantro, chopped
2 limes, cut in wedges
1/2 cup salsa
recipes.directions:
Brown the beef with the chili powder and cumin for 8 minutes.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 30 seconds per side.
Fill with beef, onion and cilantro; serve with lime and salsa.

recipes.name: Black Bean Enchiladas
recipes.ingredients:
2 cans black beans (15 oz), drained
8 flour tortillas
2 cups enchilada sauce
2 cups cheddar cheese, shredded
1 cup corn
1 tsp cumin
recipes.directions:
Heat the oven to 375°F.
Mash half the beans with the corn and cumin and fold in the rest.
Roll the filling in the tortillas, cover with sauce and cheese, and bake for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Miso Soup with Tofu
recipes.ingredients:
4 cups dashi or water
3 tbsp white miso
7 oz silken tofu, cubed
2 tbsp dried wakame
2 green onions, sliced
recipes.directions:
Bring the dashi to a simmer and add the wakame for 2 minutes.
Whisk the miso with a ladle of broth and stir it back in; do not boil.
Add the tofu and green onions and serve.

recipes.name: Chicken Teriyaki
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lbs chicken thighs
1/4 cup soy sauce
2 tbsp mirin
2 tbsp honey
1 tbsp ginger, grated
1 tbsp vegetable oil
1 tbsp sesame seeds
recipes.directions:
Sear the chicken in oil for 5 minutes per side.
Add the soy sauce, mirin, honey and ginger and simmer for 5 minutes until glossy.
Slice, spoon over the sauce and scatter sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Mapo Tofu
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb firm tofu, cubed
4 oz ground pork
2 tbsp chili bean paste
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp ginger, minced
1 cup chicken broth
1 tbsp cornstarch
2 green onions, sliced
recipes.directions:
Brown the pork for 4 minutes, then add garlic, ginger and chili bean paste for 1 minute.
Add the broth and tofu and simmer for 5 minutes.
Thicken with cornstarch mixed in water and top with green onions.

recipes.name: Vegetable Fried Rice
recipes.ingredients:
3 cups cooked rice, cold
2 eggs
1 cup frozen peas and carrots
3 green onions, sliced
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 tbsp sesame oil
2 tbsp vegetable oil
recipes.directions:
Scramble the eggs in a hot wok and set aside.
Stir-fry the vegetables for 3 minutes, add the rice and fry for 5 minutes.
Add soy sauce, sesame oil, eggs and green onions and toss.

recipes.name: Greek Village Salad
recipes.ingredients:
4 tomatoes, cut in wedges
1 cucumber, sliced
1/2 red onion, sliced
1/2 cup kalamata olives
7 oz feta cheese
3 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp dried oregano
recipes.directions:
Arrange the tomatoes, cucumber, onion and olives in a bowl.
Top with the feta, drizzle with oil and sprinkle with oregano.

recipes.name: Shakshuka
recipes.ingredients:
2 tbsp olive oil
1 onion, diced
1 bell pepper, diced
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp cumin
1 tsp paprika
1 can crushed tomatoes (28 oz)
6 eggs
1/4 cup feta cheese
recipes.directions:
Soften the onion and pepper in oil for 8 minutes; add garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.
Make six wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 6 minutes. Top with feta.

recipes.name: Bibimbap
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups cooked rice
8 oz ground beef
2 tbsp soy sauce
1 cup spinach
1 carrot, julienned
1 cup bean sprouts
4 eggs
2 tbsp gochujang
1 tbsp sesame oil
recipes.directions:
Brown the beef with soy sauce for 6 minutes.
Blanch the spinach and sprouts for 1 minute; sauté the carrot for 2 minutes.
Fry the eggs. Top bowls of rice with everything, gochujang and sesame oil.

recipes.name: Chicken Pho
recipes.ingredients:
8 cups chicken broth
1 onion, halved
1 piece ginger (3 inch)
2 star anise
1 cinnamon stick
1 lb chicken breast
8 oz rice noodles
2 tbsp fish sauce
1 cup bean sprouts
1/2 cup fresh basil leaves
1 lime, cut in wedges
recipes.directions:
Char the onion and ginger, then simmer with the broth and spices for 30 minutes.
Poach the chicken in the broth for 15 minutes, then shred it.
Soak the noodles and divide into bowls with the chicken; ladle over the strained broth with fish sauce.
Serve with sprouts, basil and lime.

recipes.name: Seafood Paella
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups short-grain rice
4 cups chicken broth
1 pinch saffron
1 onion, diced
1 bell pepper, diced
2 tsp smoked paprika
1 lb shrimp, peeled
1 lb mussels
1 cup frozen peas
3 tbsp olive oil
recipes.directions:
Soften the onion and pepper in oil for 6 minutes; stir in paprika and rice.
Add the broth and saffron and simmer without stirring for 15 minutes.
Nestle in the shrimp, mussels and peas, cover and cook for 8 minutes.

recipes.name: Jerk Chicken
recipes.ingredients:
8 chicken drumsticks
4 green onions
2 jalapenos
4 cloves garlic
1 tbsp allspice
1 tsp thyme
2 limes, juiced
2 tbsp soy sauce
2 tbsp brown sugar
recipes.directions:
Blend everything except the chicken into a paste and coat the chicken; marinate for 2 hours.
Roast at 425°F for 40 minutes, turning once.

recipes.name: Ratatouille
recipes.ingredients:
1 eggplant, cubed
2 zucchini, sliced
1 bell pepper, diced
1 onion, diced
4 tomatoes, chopped
3 cloves garlic, minced
1/4 cup olive oil
1 tsp thyme
recipes.directions:
Cook the onion and pepper in oil for 5 minutes.
Add the eggplant and zucchini and cook for 10 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, garlic and thyme and simmer for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Crispy Falafel
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups dried chickpeas, soaked overnight
1 onion, chopped
4 cloves garlic
1 cup parsley
2 tsp cumin
1 tsp coriander
1 tsp baking powder
4 cups vegetable oil, for frying
recipes.directions:
Pulse everything except the oil into a coarse paste and chill for 1 hour.
Shape into balls and fry at 350°F for 4 minutes until deep golden.
Serve in pita with tahini.
